claim_alignment.reason: The inherited recipe's assertions still map to this PR's claims: Cross badge, numeric and null venue liquidation, shared-collateral explanation, and Margin used with edit suppression. This run authored no recipe and changed no assertion.

runtime_proof.reason: Re-validation did not reach any display assertion on the rebased HEAD. 5 of 6 nodes passed (wallet, account, unlock, environment, positions) and the run stopped at require-cross, a fixture precondition asserting exactly one live position against an account that currently holds zero. No node touching this PR's code executed.

visual_evidence.reason: No screenshot or video was captured this run; execution stopped before the first capture node. The manifest references the authoring run's media purely to retain visual proof for the criteria, explicitly marked as inherited rather than fresh.

repeatability.reason: The recipe requires a live fixture it does not establish. The authoring run closed its positions and restored ETH to isolated 3x on completion, so every follow-up run fails the same gate. This is a structural replay defect, not a one-off environment glitch.

structural_findings.message: require-cross asserts a live-position precondition that no earlier node establishes, so the recipe cannot self-start from a clean account. It gates the entire display-assertion subgraph.

contextual_findings.message: Inherited finding, now realized: the fixture the recipe depends on was cleaned up by the authoring run, so this re-validation could not reproduce the display proof. Attribution was confirmed safe — the branch touches no fixture or runtime data.

suggested_recipe_delta: Add a setup branch that opens one Cross position when the account has none, so require-cross becomes an assertion the recipe can satisfy rather than an unseeded gate.
Capture the venue liquidation expectation at run time instead of pinning a numeric value, so replay does not need a refreshed expectation.
Alternatively, split the fixture gate into its own preflight recipe so a failed precondition reports as setup-missing rather than as a failed validation run.

anti_patterns: recipe cleanup that invalidates its own replay
good_patterns: per-node failure attribution before blaming the branch
diff check confirming the branch touches no fixture data
decoding bot metadata instead of trusting rendered text

reasons: The inherited recipe's claims still align with the PR, and the local gate is fully green (112/112 tests, ESLint/tsc/format clean).
But runtime re-validation proved nothing about the display code: it stopped at an unseeded live-position precondition, and no fresh visual evidence exists for the rebased HEAD.
better_version_guidance: Make the recipe seed its own Cross position so require-cross is satisfiable from a clean account, and capture the venue expectation at run time.
